_: Concept-ordering inversions that exist today, per theme, as "<claim> ← <prerequisite>".
Same two properties as curriculum-debt.json: a row that is NOT on this list fails
immediately, so nothing new drifts in; and a row on this list that has since been
fixed also fails, naming the line to delete, so the file cannot become a standing
Blackout is empty because slate B ordered its twelve in-course inversions and slate A
declared the rest; ContamCity and Hospital were re-ordered, Headwater and four editions
swapped stops. What is left is mostly structural: a game whose days are an event
calendar (Aftershock, Red Sand) or a topic list (Midway, Ground Truth) cannot be
re-ordered without breaking the story, so those rows are paid by declaring
takesAsRead on the stop or by writing the missing question.
